Problem Statement:
Tron is an expert system which, when given the board configuration and entries, determines the winner of the tic tac toe game. Given a 3*3 tic tac toe board as input, along with the filled in entries, determine which one of the players wins the game. Note: Assume player1 takes X and player2 takes O.
input_spec:
, along with the filled in entries, determine which one of the players wins the game. Note: Assume player1 takes X and player2 takes O.

Input Description:
Entries in the tic tac toe board.
output_spec: Player1/Player2 - whoever the winner is. If the game results in a tie, display “TIE”.
